name: Django CI/CD

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  PYTHON_VERSION: "3.12"
  NODE_VERSION: "20"
  DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE: config.settings
  DJANGO_SECRET_KEY: ci-test-secret-key-not-for-production
  DATABASE_URL: postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/fluvial_test

jobs:
  lint:
    name: Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ env.PYTHON_VERSION }}

      - name: Install ruff
        run: pip install ruff

      - name: Ruff check
        run: ruff check .

      - name: Ruff format check
        run: ruff format --check .

  security:
    name: Security
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ env.PYTHON_VERSION }}

      - name: Install tools
        run: pip install bandit pip-audit

      - name: Bandit scan
        run: bandit -r . -x ./tests,./.venv --severity-level medium

      - name: Audit dependencies
        run: pip-audit -r requirements.txt

  test:
    name: Test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: fluvial_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U postgres"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ env.PYTHON_VERSION }}
          cache: pip

      - name: Install system dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends libpq-dev

      - name: Install Python dependencies
        run: |
          pip install -r requirements.txt
          pip install pytest pytest-django pytest-cov

      - name: Check migrations are up to date
        run: python manage.py makemigrations --check --dry-run

      - name: Run migrations
        run: python manage.py migrate --no-input

      - name: Collect static files
        run: python manage.py collectstatic --no-input

      - name: Run tests
        run: pytest tests/ -v --cov=fluvial --cov-report=term-missing --cov-report=xml
        env:
          DATABASE_URL: postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/fluvial_test
          DJANGO_SECRET_KEY: ci-test-secret-key-not-for-production
          DEBUG: "False"

      - name: Upload coverage
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: coverage-report
          path: coverage.xml
          retention-days: 7

  build:
    name: Build Docker Image
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [lint, security, test]
    if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: write

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Log in to GHCR
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          registry: ghcr.io
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Extract metadata
        id: meta
        uses: docker/metadata-action@v5
        with:
          images: ghcr.io/${{ github.repository }}
          tags: |
            type=sha,prefix=
            type=raw,value=latest

      - name: Build and push
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
        with:
          context: .
          file: Dockerfile.django
          push: true
          tags: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.tags }}
          labels: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.labels }}
          cache-from: type=gha
          cache-to: type=gha,mode=max

  deploy-staging:
    name: Deploy to Staging
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build
    environment: staging
    concurrency:
      group: deploy-staging
      cancel-in-progress: false

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Deploy to staging server
        uses: appleboy/ssh-action@v1
        with:
          host: ${{ secrets.STAGING_HOST }}
          username: ${{ secrets.STAGING_USER }}
          key: ${{ secrets.STAGING_SSH_KEY }}
          script: |
            cd ${{ secrets.STAGING_DEPLOY_PATH }}
            docker compose pull app
            docker compose up -d --no-deps app
            docker compose exec -T app python manage.py migrate --no-input
            docker compose exec -T app python manage.py collectstatic --no-input
            echo "Deployed ${{ github.sha }} to staging"

      - name: Health check
        run: |
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -sf "${{ secrets.STAGING_URL }}/health/" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "Staging is healthy"
              exit 0
            fi
            echo "Waiting for staging... ($i/30)"
            sleep 10
          done
          echo "Health check failed"
          exit 1

  deploy-production:
    name: Deploy to Production
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: deploy-staging
    environment: production
    concurrency:
      group: deploy-production
      cancel-in-progress: false

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Deploy to production server
        uses: appleboy/ssh-action@v1
        with:
          host: ${{ secrets.PRODUCTION_HOST }}
          username: ${{ secrets.PRODUCTION_USER }}
          key: ${{ secrets.PRODUCTION_SSH_KEY }}
          script: |
            cd ${{ secrets.PRODUCTION_DEPLOY_PATH }}
            docker compose pull app
            docker compose up -d --no-deps app
            docker compose exec -T app python manage.py migrate --no-input
            docker compose exec -T app python manage.py collectstatic --no-input
            echo "Deployed ${{ github.sha }} to production"

      - name: Health check
        run: |
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -sf "${{ secrets.PRODUCTION_URL }}/health/" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "Production is healthy"
              exit 0
            fi
            echo "Waiting for production... ($i/30)"
            sleep 10
          done
          echo "Health check failed"
          exit 1
